title: French Makers: Avalanche Titanium Cages + Copra Panniers
content:
Avalanche is launching a new artisan partnership with Timothée from Copra Bags, whose workshop is a few kilometers from theirs. If you recall, Marie displayed Timothée’s gravel bike at Bespoked Dresden this year. From that collaboration and others over the years, the two Parisian brands joined forces to offer up a titanium cargo cage and pannier set (€285)…

Copra Bags designed a set of side bags specifically for use with titanium cages, manufactured by the Avalanche team in its workshop. Each bag offers a maximum volume of 4.5 liters and is spacious enough to easily store camping gear, food, or spare clothing thanks to its rigid back and rear attachment system. Each bag has its own small, independent pocket, allowing for optimal organization, even in a compact package. Each bag is equipped with a durable and robust Fidlock magnetic buckle that opens and closes easily with one hand.

Avalanche titanium fork cages attach to fork eyelets at three points. They are entirely designed and manufactured in France at the Avalanche workshop.

Check it all out at Avalanche Cycles.
